# BatchParallelismCoordinator

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BatchParallelismCoordinator`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Coordinates batch parallelism across all concurrent bulk operations. Ensures total concurrent batches never exceed pool&#x27;s recommended DOP.
